target_customer: Frontier AI labs buying reinforcement learning environments for post-training
problem: Frontier models fail more than 80 percent of the time on hard science reasoning and performance engineering tasks, and labs need verifiable environments to train on.
business_model: Sale of RL environments and evaluation data to AI labs, with a public leaderboard

founders.name: Dillon Mehta
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no bio beyond title.

founders.name: Neel Gadde
founders.background_notes: YC lists COO but his bio says Co-Founder and CRO.

founders.name: Rishan Hemrajani
founders.background_notes: YC bio says Co-Founder and CTO.

competitors.name: Mechanize
competitors.what: Builds a few robust RL environments; reported working with Anthropic
competitors.traction_then: TechCrunch reported lab work in September 2025

competitors.name: Prime Intellect
competitors.what: Open Environments Hub with community RL environments and hosted RL post-training

competitors.name: FutureHouse
competitors.what: Aviary RL environments for science agents

technical_complexity.rationale: Designing verifiable scientific and performance tasks that frontier models fail, with contamination resistance and reward correctness, needs domain and RL expertise.

defensibility.rationale: Environments are copyable by labs and many funded rivals; value depends on task quality and lab relationships.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Human-data firms had added environments by 2026; no CueBench-specific action found.

market_need_then: Labs invested heavily in RL environments from September 2025, reported by TechCrunch, and RL for science was a focus area in 2026.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Technical, benchmark-led with leaderboards and a double pendulum example

branding.brand_signature: Public leaderboards ranking frontier models, planned

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand; search mixes it with Cua-Bench and an unrelated workforce analytics description.

outcome_analysis: CueBench is a Summer 2026 company in the crowded RL environment market that surged after 2025. The founders have no public bios, and no traction or customers are disclosed. Whether it wins depends on lab relationships and task quality against well funded rivals.
notes: CB Insights lists a roughly $500K convertible note, one aggregator figure, unverified, so no round recorded. One source described CueBench as workforce analytics, which conflicts with YC and is treated as wrong. A secondary claim that Mechanize was acqui-hired is unverified and omitted. Founder backgrounds not found. Completeness pass: the roughly 500K convertible note is recorded from CB Insights alone, date not given by the source; terms unknown.
